# Vietlott Data

> Open, daily-updated historical dataset of every Vietlott (Vietnam) lottery draw result: Power 6/55, Mega 6/45, Power 5/35, Keno, Max 3D, Max 3D Pro, and Bingo18. Crawled from the official vietlott.vn, stored as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), MIT licensed. Bộ dữ liệu mở kết quả xổ số Vietlott đầy đủ từ kỳ quay đầu tiên, cập nhật hàng ngày.

## Scope & Interpretation
- **Historical & Latest Draw Data**: Raw NDJSON files in `data/` record every verified historical draw from the official Vietlott results pages up to the most recent daily draw.
- **Statistical Summaries**: The website and README publish descriptive historical statistics (draw counts, number frequencies, days since last appearance).
- **Randomness Disclaimer**: Historical frequencies describe past draws only. Lottery outcomes are independent random events and cannot be predicted or forecast reliably. Data is provided strictly for education, data engineering, and statistical research.

## Record Schemas by Product
Each line in `data/*.jsonl` is a standalone JSON object representing one draw:

- **Power 6/55** (`data/power655.jsonl`, since 2017-08-01):
  `{"date":"2026-10-29","id":"01417","result":[9,29,33,38,45,46,53],"process_time":"2026-10-29T12:00:05Z"}`
  `result` is an array of **7 integers**: the first 6 are the main winning numbers (1–55, sorted) and the 7th (last) number is the special/bonus number (Jackpot 2).
- **Mega 6/45** (`data/power645.jsonl`, since 2017-10-25):
  `{"date":"2026-10-28","id":"01581","result":[1,9,11,28,33,42],"process_time":"2026-10-28T12:00:07Z"}`
  `result` is an array of **6 integers**: the 6 main winning numbers (1–45, sorted). **Mega 6/45 has NO bonus/special number.**
- **Power 5/35** (`data/power535.jsonl`, since 2025-06-29):
  `{"date":"2026-10-29","id":"00976","result":[5,13,22,26,35,3],"process_time":"2026-10-30T00:00:07Z"}`
  `result` is an array of **6 integers**: the first 5 are main winning numbers (1–35, sorted) and the 6th (last) number is the special/bonus number.
- **Keno** (`data/keno.jsonl`, since 2022-12-04):
  `{"date":"2026-10-30","id":"#0301098","result":[1,4,5,6,8,13,18,20,23,24,25,29,34,41,42,49,57,75,79,80],"big_small":"Lẻ (11)","odd_even":"Nhỏ (13)"}`
  `result` is an array of **20 integers** (drawn from 1–80), accompanied by `big_small` and `odd_even` summary fields (`id` is prefixed with `#`).
- **Max 3D** (`data/3d.jsonl`, since 2019-04-22) & **Max 3D Pro** (`data/3d_pro.jsonl`, since 2021-09-14):
  `{"date":"2026-10-28","id":"01151","result":{"Giải Đặc biệt":["692","005"],"Giải Nhất":["621","118","707","412"],"Giải Nhì":["335","265","268","222","917","484"],"Giải ba":["099","875","590","161","801","076","841","957"]}}`
  `result` is a **JSON object** mapping the 4 Vietnamese prize tier names (`Giải Đặc biệt`, `Giải Nhất`, `Giải Nhì`, `Giải ba`) to arrays of 3-digit strings (20 triplets total per draw).
- **Bingo18** (`data/bingo18.jsonl`, since 2024-12-03):
  `{"date":"2026-10-30","id":"0193681","result":[3,5,5],"total":13,"large_small":"Lớn","process_time":"2026-10-30T00:00:28Z"}`
  `result` is an array of **3 integers** (each 1–6), with `total` (sum 3–18), `large_small` (`Nhỏ` / `Hòa` / `Lớn`), and `process_time`.

## Data files (raw NDJSON)
- [Power 6/55](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/power655.jsonl): Vietlott Power 6/55 results (6 main + 1 bonus number)
- [Mega 6/45](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/power645.jsonl): Vietlott Mega 6/45 results (6 winning numbers, no bonus number)
- [Power 5/35](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/power535.jsonl): Vietlott Power 5/35 results (5 main + 1 special number)
- [Keno](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/keno.jsonl): Vietlott Keno results (20 numbers from 1–80 per draw)
- [Max 3D](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/3d.jsonl): Vietlott Max 3D results (prize tier map of 3-digit strings)
- [Max 3D Pro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/3d_pro.jsonl): Vietlott Max 3D Pro results (prize tier map of 3-digit strings)
- [Bingo18](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/bingo18.jsonl): Vietlott Bingo18 results (3 numbers from 1–6, sum 3–18)

## Pages & Documentation
- [Vietnamese Homepage](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/): Interactive statistics, analysis, downloads, and FAQ
- [English Homepage](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/en/): Complete English version of the dataset portal
- [Power 6/55 Dataset Page](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/power-6-55/): Historical Power 6/55 stats, recent draws, and number frequencies
- [Mega 6/45 Dataset Page](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/mega-6-45/): Historical Mega 6/45 stats, recent draws, and number frequencies
- [Power 5/35 Dataset Page](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/power-5-35/): Historical Power 5/35 stats, recent draws, and number frequencies
- [Keno Dataset Page](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/keno/): High-frequency Keno dataset overview and processing guide
- [Max 3D Dataset Page](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/max-3d/): Max 3D prize-tier dataset overview and recent draws
- [Max 3D Pro Dataset Page](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/max-3d-pro/): Max 3D Pro dataset overview and recent draws
- [Bingo18 Dataset Page](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/bingo18/): Bingo18 3-dice dataset overview and recent draws
- [Data Schema Reference](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/data-schema/): Complete NDJSON field definitions and sample records for all 7 products
- [Python & Polars Examples](https://vietvudanh.github.io/vietlott-data/python-examples/): Code examples for loading NDJSON with Polars, Pandas, DuckDB, and Go
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data): Source code, Go crawler (`bin/vietlott-crawler`, recommended), and Python package (`vietlott-data` on PyPI)
- [Deployment & Architecture](https://github.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)
- [Crawler Benchmark (Go vs Python)](https://github.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK.md)
- [Author Blog Post](https://open.substack.com/pub/vietvudanh/p/minh-a-tao-repo-vietlott-data-the)
